lesson.theme: Taxi/airport interaction, prices, noun-based reasons, inability, adverbs, negative commands, and 르 irregulars
situations: describing how an action is done
goals: Use N(이)라서 for 'because it is N'
Use -지 못하다 as a long-form inability expression
Give negative commands with -지 마세요 and alternatives with -지 말고
Read larger Sino-Korean numbers and prices

grammar.name: Reason with a noun/copula
grammar.meaning: Expresses 'because it is N'; the negative form in the lesson is N이/가 아니라서, 'because it is not N.'

examples.en: Because I'm a student, I don't have money.
Because it's a holiday, the road is congested.

examples.ko: 한국 사람이 아니라서 한국말을 잘 못 해요.
examples.en: Because I'm not Korean, I can't speak Korean well.

contrast.note: Use 때문에 for 'because of N'; N(이)라서 means 'because it is N.'

grammar.name: Long-form inability
grammar.meaning: Expresses inability to perform an action; the PPT presents it as slightly more formal than short 못 + verb.
formation: future/prospective forms can attach after 못하다 as needed

examples.en: I couldn't go to the party.

contrast.note: Both express inability; -지 못하다 is presented as a longer/slightly more formal form.

commonMistakes: Do not confuse inability with simple 'not doing' (안/-지 않다).

grammar.name: Adverbial -게
grammar.meaning: Turns many adjectives into adverbial modifiers describing how an action happens.

grammar.name: Negative command / prohibition
grammar.meaning: Tells someone not to do an action.

examples.en: Please don't talk loudly in the library.

grammar.name: Don't X; do Y instead
grammar.meaning: Combines a negative command with a positive alternative.

examples.en: Don't drink coffee; have tea instead.

grammar.name: 르 irregular predicates
grammar.meaning: When a 르-final stem is followed by 아/어, the ㅡ is deleted and an additional ㄹ appears on the preceding syllable.
commonMistakes: The irregular change described here is triggered by 아/어-type endings; formal -ㅂ니다 forms shown in the PPT are 부릅니다/모릅니다/빠릅니다.

grammar.name: Prices and large Sino-Korean numbers
grammar.meaning: Taxi fares and prices use Sino-Korean numbers; the lesson reviews 십, 백, 천, 만 and larger combinations.

examples.en: How much did the bill/fare come to?

expressions.meaningEn: Where are you going? (How far/what destination?)
How much did it come to?
Thank you for your work / Keep up the good work / Thank you for what you just did

culture.title: 수고하세요 is context-sensitive
culture.summary: The teacher distinguishes 수고하세요 from 수고하셨어요/수고하셨습니다: the first can acknowledge ongoing work, while the latter thank someone for work just completed.

practice.prompt: Which means 'Because it is a holiday, the road is congested'?
Change 못 가요 to the long-form inability expression.

practice.explanation: A-게 turns the adjective into an adverb modifying the verb.

practice.prompt: Conjugate 모르다 in polite present tense.
practice.explanation: 르 + 아/어 triggers the 르-irregular pattern: 모르다 → 몰라요.

practice.prompt: Which means 'Don't take a taxi; take the subway instead'?
practice.explanation: -지 말고 rejects X and then gives Y as the alternative.
